title: let/for/catch bindings accept uppercase spellings
purpose: Accept uppercase local binding names in every binding form spec 4.3 lists.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 4.3: let, for and catch bindings accept [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]* including USER_NAME, A, UserName; the for prints 9 and 1+2+3+10 = 16.
